name: West Edmonton Mall
slides: West Edmonton Mall at a glance
Built in 1985, World Waterpark covers 20,903 m². Its wave pool, the world's largest indoors, makes waves up to two metres high.
From 1985 to 2005, four submarines toured the mall's lake, a record holder as the world's largest indoor lake. A Santa María replica sits there.
Guinness listed it as the largest indoor shopping centre in the world until 2004. Its parking lot, with 20,000+ spaces, holds a record too.

caption:
This Edmonton mall has the world's largest indoor wave pool 🇨🇦

West Edmonton Mall opened in 1981 and was the biggest mall on Earth until 2004. Inside: a waterpark with two-metre waves, a lake where submarines once gave tours, and a replica of Columbus's Santa María.

Would you go for the shops or the waves? 👇
